powercfg_visibility_unavailable_reason: Non-elevated requests query denied; no bypass attempted

readonly_policy_override.scope: Read-only optional HKLM policy override inspection

integration: Use PowerRequestGuard(reason) as a context in the next supervisor before the long task; call heartbeat() in its existing loop, persist wall/monotonic gaps, and stop/invalidate if scheduling_gap_exceeded. Preserve the independently declared original deadline. Exit clears only this process request counts and closes its handle.
documented_limits: SystemRequired addresses idle sleep; ExecutionRequired addresses process lifetime management.
User-initiated sleep can terminate both requests. Modern Standby DC power has documented request duration limits.
No display, away-mode, lid, battery, registry or power-scheme changes are made.
